Frequently Asked Questions

What is the actual GPU TGP wattage of ASUS Vivobook Pro 15 OLED (M6500QC)?

The ASUS Vivobook Pro 15 OLED (M6500QC) features a 50W TGP (NVIDIA Studio Certified Drivers) rating for its NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 4GB GDDR6. This ensures stable framerates without thermal throttling under sustained gaming loads.

Can I upgrade the RAM and SSD on this laptop?

Yes! It has Onboard + 1x SO-DIMM and 1x M.2 NVMe slot. You can easily drop in an additional 16GB RAM stick or high-speed Gen4 NVMe SSD at home without voiding warranty.

Is this laptop recommended for programming, coding, and college?

ASUS Vivobook Pro 15 OLED (M6500QC) scores 9.4/10 for software engineering. Its AMD Ryzen 5 5600H (6 Cores, 12 Threads, up to 4.2 GHz) easily handles Docker, multiple IDEs, compiling code, and virtual machines.
